# Bengali Cultural Association Barcelona

> BCA Spain (Bengali Cultural Association Barcelona) is a registered non-profit founded in 2022. We keep Bengali culture alive in Barcelona through Durga Puja, Rabindra Jayanti, concerts, language, food, and community programmes for Bengalis and friends in Spain.

Primary language: English. Blog posts may include Bengali with English summaries. Contact: info@bcaspain.org · WhatsApp: +34 693 005 986 · Barcelona, Catalunya, Spain.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://bcaspain.org/blog/): Stories, guides, and voices from the Bengali community in Barcelona
- [Is Asana Practice all about Flexibility?](https://bcaspain.org/blog/is-asana-practice-all-about-flexibility.html): You don't have to be flexible to do yoga. BCA member Chandana Bhowmick on Ashtanga, strength, and how body and mind grow together on the mat.
- [My India Experience](https://bcaspain.org/blog/my-india-experience.html): Manuel G. Marciani on his three-week journey through India — hospitality, languages, faith, and what Europe might learn from how diversity coexists.
- [Mutton Gora Kalia — recipe](https://bcaspain.org/blog/mutton-gora-kalia.html): Surashree's Bengali mutton Gora Kalia from Sharodiya 2025 — a rich, slow-cooked curry perfect for festive tables. Recipe in Bengali with English summary.
- [Notun Generation aar Durga Pujo](https://bcaspain.org/blog/notun-generation-durga-pujo.html): Debmalya Roy on keeping Durga Puja alive for probashi kids — participation, Benglish, and passing Bengali culture on. From Sharodiya 2025.
- [Pompeii — a Bengali travel diary](https://bcaspain.org/blog/pompeii-arnab-sarkar.html): Arnab Sarkar on a day trip from Barcelona to Pompeii — Vesuvius, Roman streets, and a city frozen in AD 79. Bengali essay with English summary. From Sharodiya 2025.
- [The tragic hard worker](https://bcaspain.org/blog/the-tragic-hard-worker.html): Tamojit Kumar Manna on why donkeys deserve more credit — from গাধা insults to Fanny, the BBC's smartest donkey. From Sharodiya 2025.
